value.rationale: A single vertex removal from Q_d produces a sharp parity-fractured change from ambient square-zero or involutory dynamics to a size-three nilpotent chain or an exceptional transient eigenline. The exact classification of all attractors and stopping times for every d and finite characteristic-two field is a natural, previously unaccounted network fault invariant distinct from edge/feedback defects.
